scientific_integrity: Analytic proof plus finite numerical regression; no independent mathematical validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only local period pairs are reached; the third period is fixed; no classification of other cycles, arbitrary three-period prescription or global injection is implied. Strict geometric disjointness, fixed nonzero lambda and beta, and sufficiently large positive gamma are essential. Historical-priority caveat applies.
title: Two independently tunable periods with a frozen third clock in quartic three-circle flows
